               <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5999">bu ston rin po che</rs>'i <expan>zhal ta</expan> nas mdzad <expan>pa'i</expan> <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:7368">rnaM bshad lung gi snye ma</rs> dang | de nyid chan nyid kyis mdzad pa dang gsung sgros dharma'i mtshan can gyis <expan>phyogs</expan> <expan>gcig</expan> tu bkod <expan>pa'i</expan> zin ris <expan>nas snangs</expan> rnaMs <expan>ba'i</expan> de nyid las khong du chud par bya bas 'dir ma bris <lb n="48b8"/> shing spyi don gyi gnas rnaMs na rgal zhing rtag pa bya ba mang du snang na yang | blo gsal 'jug pa bde <expan>ba'i</expan> don du re zhig 'dir bskus pa'o ||</seg></TEI>
